title: Data and code for: How Long, Not How Much: Exposure Duration Outranks Concentration in an Eighteen-Modality Satellite and Reanalysis Fusion for United States County Life Expectancy
description:
Exposure duration outranks concentration in predicting United States county life expectancy

This deposit contains the assembled county-year panel, the fitted model, every intermediate result table, and every figure for the study published in Sensors. The analysis code is at https://github.com/albertfaiz/how-long-not-how-much.

Derived data are released under CC-BY-4.0. The original products remain under their providers' licenses.
